name: Interpreting and Translating Centre
shortDescription: Confidential interpreting and translating services for South Australians in more than 100 languages and dialects.
plainEnglishSummary: If you need help communicating in another language, ITC may provide an interpreter for a meeting, phone call, hospital visit or legal appointment, or translate written documents.
audience: South Australians who need spoken-language interpreting
People who need documents translated from or into English
Businesses and organisations requiring language services
People requiring some Aboriginal language interpreting services
availabilityNote: Office hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm. Online enquiries and booking requests can be submitted at any time. For same-day or next-day interpreting requests, call 1800 280 203. Fees depend on the language, service type, location, duration and complexity.
eligibilityNote: Community Connect cannot confirm interpreter availability, turnaround time or cost. Contact ITC for a quote and to confirm whether the required language and service type are available. ITC does not provide Auslan interpreting; users requiring Auslan should contact an appropriate Auslan provider.
